system.description:
Play the Raconteur if you want to use clever wordplay and captivate hearts and crowds.

Features

Rousing Speech. Once per Rest, you may deliver a stirring call to action. Allies who can hear you feel their burdens lifting, clearing 2 Stress.

Heart of a Poet. After attempting to impress, persuade, or scandalize someone with an Action Roll, but before the GM shares the result, you may spend a Hope to add an extra flourish, adding 1d4 to the result.
